nodes.title: Tagged Ref2VA Conditioning
widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
@courier_arrival defines <Subject 1>, the exact adult bicycle courier, including his face, mustard-yellow waterproof jacket, dark teal trousers, charcoal helmet, olive messenger bag, silver bicycle, kraft parcel, proportions, and photographic rendering.
@greenhouse_delivery defines the greenhouse delivery destination, including the glass structure, wooden potting table, dense plants, warm practical bulbs, wet floor reflections, and the same courier's end pose.
<Subject 1> is the single courier shown by both references. Preserve his identity, clothing, equipment, and scale while allowing the described movement.

summary:
[reference generation] One continuous delivery moves <Subject 1> from the wet greenhouse entrance in @courier_arrival toward the completed parcel placement in @greenhouse_delivery.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the exact face, adult age, body proportions, mustard jacket, teal trousers, helmet, bag, bicycle, and parcel across the complete shot.
@courier_arrival: fully_preserved - use its courier identity, wardrobe, bicycle geometry, exterior doorway, wet paving, camera height, and cool daylight as the opening state.
@greenhouse_delivery: reference - use its potting table, plants, warm bulbs, interior reflections, and delivery pose as the destination; do not copy the final pose before the action reaches it.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] Begin at the greenhouse entrance with exactly one courier and one bicycle. He walks the bicycle through the open glass door, glances down to confirm the parcel, then turns toward the wooden potting table. The camera tracks laterally at walking speed with restrained handheld movement. He stops the bicycle with his left hand and sets the parcel on the clear corner of the table with his right hand. Preserve face, hands, clothing, bicycle structure, parcel dimensions, plant layout, lighting direction, and coherent reflections. End immediately after the parcel makes contact; no cut, duplicate subject, added customer, text, logo, or early freeze.

overall_soundscape:
Light rain on greenhouse glass, wet tire roll, a quiet freewheel tick, rubber soles, door hinge, jacket movement, muted ventilation, and soft cardboard contact on wood. Keep every sound synchronized and spatially plausible.

non_diegetic_music:
No non-diegetic music.

nodes.title: Plan Studio
Production Plan
START HERE • 0.7
widgets_values:
0.7 • 0.6 CATALOG • Ref2V Studio SelfLift Seed Hunt - EXPERIMENTAL

1. Use a new run name or a duplicate project; install/select the usual H3 model, encoder and VAEs.
2. Import the supplied courier reference assets as in Ref2V Studio.
3. Leave SelfLift Project OFF for ordinary sampling, or select a compatible latent upscaler and enable it.
4. Plan size is FINAL size. Use Euler; set high-resolution steps below the scene's total.
5. Inspect a short clip and its continuation before committing to a full project.
6. Keep the seed control fixed. Set candidate_count and batch_name on Seed Hunt; Queue, play the low-pass previews, optionally Preview upscale, then mark takes to upscale and choose one main. Set review_enabled=false for automatic sampling without tiny previews; the final Review Gate is separate.
7. After OOM or reboot, Queue the same workflow with the same batch name, base seed and generation settings. Saved low passes are reused; an approved take skips directly to high resolution. A finished high pass is also cached for downstream decode retries. Browser refresh alone is not a new job.
8. The Seed Hunt dropdown lists saved batches. Download saved workflow if needed. Changing batch_name starts a fresh hunt. Changing model, LoRA, prompt, context or schedule creates a separate batch; old takes remain on disk.
9. Keep selected_state wired to Trim, Segment Save, final Review Gate and Loop End so the chosen seed is recorded. Saved candidates are retained, not automatically deleted.


Recovery is disabled by default. Enable it only to assemble saved clips without sampling.
